messages:
harper: Quick sync  mini webinar tomorrow. Need: X teaser, LinkedIn long-thread, 30s clip push. Who's owning copy + asset QA?
diego: I can take copy for both. Need mp4 clip, thumbnail (16:9), transcript, and headshots.
neha: Ops will export clip + transcript by 10:00 PT. @samir can you do thumbnails + a 10s motion GIF? deadline 11:30 PT.
samir: Yep. I'll deliver 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 PNGs + 10s GIF and a square thumbnail for X.
harper: Cadence: X teaser 09:00 PT, LinkedIn thread 12:00 PT, clip follow-up ~24h later. Approvals needed by 08:45 PT.
diego: Messaging decision: lead with benchmark (latency/cost) or customer story? Benchmarks pull but legal may delay.
neha: Backup copy: anonymized stat + short quote. Eg "~2x inference cost reduction" as placeholder. If legal not green, drop the number.
diego: Draft thread I'll post by 07:30 for review. Quick outline: hook -> pain -> anonymized result -> tactics (batching, quant, cache) -> CTA rwd.in/miniweb
samir: For LinkedIn I'll create an image with the anon stat callout and speaker pull-quote using launch palette v4.
harper: Routing: signups tag -> "miniweb-2026". UTMs: source=social_x / social_li. SDRs get Slack ping + email.
neha: Confirmed. Also add lead field: "interest=miniweb" for CRM mapping.
diego: Engagement plan: reply to top 5 comments within 1h; amplify best comment into a quote post. Who handles first 30m replies?
samir: I'll do initial triage then hand off to community.
schedule-bot: Drafts created and queued: X teaser (09:00 PT), LinkedIn thread (12:00 PT). Will publish automatically if approvals present by 08:45 PT.
harper: Approval flow: diego -> neha -> legal (only if numbers). If legal not back by 08:45, swap to quote-only.
diego: I'll run A/B on the first hook (technical vs customer) and report lift in postmortem.
neha: Assets will be uploaded to /shared/marketing/assets/miniweb-spark by 10:30. I'll drop links here when ready.
harper: Post-launch tracking: CTR, signups, CPL, ER. 15m postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT to iterate messaging.
samir: Uploaded thumbs; pinged in drive.
schedule-bot: Once final_approval=YES posts will go live at scheduled times.
